comment: The high test is an exact float comparison with 10.0f (src/L-Carrier.cpp:83), which the maker's own doc states as well (docs/L-Carrier.md, Functionality Overview). It is the single most surprising thing about the module and is written into the input's line for that reason. The output named Nor in configOutput is the NOT_OUT_OUTPUT enum member, and the panel prints Nor; it carries the NOR of A and B, so the enum name is an internal misnomer only. This module has no parameters at all.
